method: Hand review of design/parity/evidence/<row>/comparison.png (reference, built, pixelmatch diff) against Material Design 3 component anatomy and the checked-in reference.

primitives.finding: Built overlay is a centred 975 px dialog inside the 1040 px shell; the reference is a 1000 px sheet. Same anatomy, narrower gutters.
Matches / Explain / Replace / Export / Cheat sheet / Dialects segmented tabs present with live counts; no label elides at 1040 px.
ECMAScript / QRegularExpression / Both segmented control in the header, driving flag captions, exports and the dialect cards; subtitle states PCRE2 is the engine that runs.
Searchable preset library with the ten shipped presets under the token palette.
Explain tab lists tokens with spans and selects them in the pattern; the reference's drag-to-reorder token-block strip is not built.
Sample text and match/capture list present.

defects.summary: Token-block strip with drag-to-reorder not built; Explain tab covers token listing and selection only

deviations.summary: Overlay width 975 px versus the reference 1000 px sheet because the built shell is 1040 px wide at this tuple
deviations.reason: The overlay keeps 32 px shell gutters; anatomy and order match
